title: My grandfather's life
instructions: Elif dedesinin hayatını anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; yılları, yaşları ve olayların sırasını takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: My grandfather, Hasan, was born in a small village in nineteen forty-eight.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: His family were farmers, and he had four brothers and two sisters.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: When he was fourteen, he left school and started working on the farm.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: At twenty, he moved to Izmir and found a job in a factory.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: He met my grandmother there. She worked in the factory office.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: They got married in nineteen seventy-two and had three children. My mother is the youngest.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: Later, my grandfather opened a small shoe shop. He worked there for thirty years.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: He never went to university, but he loved reading. He read a newspaper every morning.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: Now he is retired. He lives with my grandmother in a house with a big garden.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: He grows tomatoes and peppers, and he still walks five kilometres every day.
